text:
sam.k: quick sync: compliance asked for stronger guarantees on "who changed what" for export/downloads. they want a signed export provenance header + tenant routing visibility in the console. thinking: record routing_reason, routing_decision, and presigned_fallback bool on the export event. also add a small green/yellow/red pill in the export history row for "routed"/"fallback"/"queued".

anya: +1. Signed header could be: `X-Export-Proof: sha256=<hex>, signer=redwood, exported_at=...` so legal can verify integrity. We should include model_variant and shard_id in the proof.

drew: Concern: exporting full payload for proof increases sensitive surface. We can hash the payload and store the hash + redaction map. Keep full payload only for 30d if tenant opt-in for ediscovery.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing-service v2 promoted to staging at 2026-03-22T09:12:01Z :package:

ops: Alerting: if dedicated_export_queue_depth > 75% for >4m, page infra-team and create a muted slack incident in #incidents. Also track per-tenant export_rate spikes (>10 exports/min sustained 2m).

compliance: We Need ability to export the export-audit as NDJSON for legal. Include event fields: event_id, tenant_id, actor, routing_decision, routing_reason, proof_hash, presigned_url_meta (no url), timestamp. Don't include full PII in the top-level audit event.

sam.k: UX thought: export list row can have a kebab menu -> "View routing details" which opens a drawer with last rule match, TTL remaining, and link to presigned delivery log if fallback used.

anya: Implementation note: routing_decision enum = [DEDICATED, HOSTED, FALLBACK_PRESIGNED] (strings). routing_reason should reference rule_id not free text to make grouping/counting easier. We'll keep a rule catalog table.

drew: For fallback presigned flow: flow should generate short-lived presigned object, return 202 Accepted with poll_url. Polling returns status and signed proof when complete. This avoids synchronous blocking of hosted lanes.

sam.k: We also need a migration plan: for historical exports we only have partial metadata. Propose we backfill routing_decision where logs exist, otherwise mark UNKNOWN and surface that in the export history as faded.

ops: Runtime logs should include `export.request_id`, `routing_rule_id`, and `dedicated_pool_shard`. Add these to logs before we redact payloads.

anya: Security note: store presigned_url_meta (bucket, key_len, expires_at) but never store the full presigned_url. Also rotate signer keys monthly for `X-Export-Proof`.

sam.k: Action items: 1) Anya - schema PR + rule catalog table (ETA 2d). 2) Drew - presigned fallback API + poll contract (ETA 5d). 3) Ops - add alerts and runbook snippet (ETA 1d). 4) UI - small pill + drawer (I'll sketch, ETA 1w).

drew: one more: rate-limit exports per-tenant with a leaky-bucket and surface remaining_quota in the UI so customers see when they're approaching the dedicated pool cap.

compliance: please add a download for NDJSON proof bundle with optional signed-manifest for court submission.

sam.k: noted. we'll include signed-manifest option in export endpoint.

ops: FYI, for retention: proofs and hashes 90 days, payload sampling 30 days. We'll need S3 lifecycle policy for the ediscovery buckets.

anya: I'll include unit tests for proof header generation and key rotation. also add a migration job to compute proof_hash for existing artifacts where possible.

sam.k: thanks. If no objections i'll file the RFC and start canary. small ask from compliance: enable per-tenant opt-in to keep full payload for litigation holds (default off).

compliance: that's required. we'll coordinate on access controls.

drew: sounds good. i'll post the presigned API sketch in the PR.

sam.k: great, closing this thread. will post links to RFC + UI mocks when available. :wave:
